item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 22/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The tropical cyclone over the northeastern part of the South China Sea is expected to move across the northern part of the South China Sea today and tomorrow. Its circulation is relatively small, and its intensity is also rather weak. A fresh to strong replenishment of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of southern China tomorrow night. It will be windy, mainly fine and dry over the region in the following couple of days.

Date/Month: 23/10 (Sunday)
Wind: Northeast force 4 to 5, east force 5 at night, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. There will be swells.
Temp range: 23 - 28 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
